$comment: Scraper integration test files that the pr-gate job `scraper-document-integration`
deliberately does NOT run. Enforced by scripts/ci/require-integration-test-coverage.mjs:
every file under scraper/tests/integration/ must be in the job's run list or in here.
kind 'cannot-run-in-ci' = hits a live external site / needs the prod tunnel / needs a
credential CI does not have. kind 'broken' = cannot currently run anywhere; it needs a
tracking issue, because a broken test hiding inside 'excluded' is exactly the silence
Paths are relative to scraper/ and must name one file exactly — no wildcards.

exclusions.reason: Calls testNSEAPIConnection() and scrapeNSEAPI() against the LIVE nseindia.com API (cookie handshake, real rate limits). A CI runner's IP is blocked by NSE and the result would be non-deterministic; it is a manual connectivity probe, not a gate. Measured 2026-09-26 against ipodhan_test: 31/32 assertions passed, 1 failed on a live-data shape mismatch (no employeeSubscription field on the IPO NSE currently serves) — confirming it is a live-network probe, not a deterministic gate.
